name: Security Incidents
blurb: Major AI security events as they are disclosed.

reading.body:
Lambda accounts for the most persistent open incidents in this dataset, with 62 of 96 observed periods showing an active incident and a peak of 3 simultaneous open cases, more than any other tracked provider.

The daily series runs from mid-August to September 1, 2026, and shows a clear pattern: incident counts were highest in the August 19–24 window, reaching 4 on two separate days, then fell sharply toward the end of the period. Whether that decline reflects faster resolution, fewer new events, or a reporting lag is not determinable from this data alone. The series records disclosed incidents only, so the floor at any given date is a disclosure count, not an occurrence count.

The provider breakdown covers six named entities out of twelve total tracked. OpenAI had the second-highest observation count with incidents at 11 of 102 periods, while Anthropic, ElevenLabs, and Baseten each showed incidents in fewer than 5 periods. The data does not identify the remaining six providers, so the aggregate daily totals cannot be fully attributed. Nothing in this dataset connects incidents to compute capacity, power draw, or physical infrastructure, so no such inference is warranted here.
